answer: Agents enter through a ridge checkpoint. First, one hardware key is bound and a 60 POA deposit locked. Next, five reviewers on the ridge stamp each finished job violet once the client signs off. Then a random pulse audit weekly re-runs three of their last twenty jobs; a mismatch burns the deposit and freezes the key sixty days. Thirty violet stamps and two clean audits earn full standing. Forging a thousand fakes costs 60,000 POA, 30,000 graded jobs and two thousand audits, 15,000 dollars and ninety days. Like a trail where each step leaves a violet print, fakes leave the wrong prints.
